title: Beautiful, but
text:
Beautiful, but. Very beautiful! I love the irregularity, these sre not perfectly round plates or bowls. I enjoy the lightly dimpled texture too.

This may be my own fault but apparently while this are dishwasher safe they are NOT microwave safe. So these are only for serving, not heating yp food on. Just be aware.
